detector.description: Alerts when a business transaction's error rate degrades relative to its historical baselines from the last 12 hours, yesterday, and last week.
detector.name: APM Business Transaction Error Rate Increased
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.autodetect.apm import errors
errors.blended_business_transaction(headroom=1.65).publish("Error Rate Increased")

rules.description: Business transaction error rate is worse than it has been over the last 12 hours, the same time yesterday, and the same time last week.
rules.tip: See the signalflow powering this detector: https://cd.splunkdev.com/observability/imm/signalflow-library/-/blob/master/library/signalfx/detectors/autodetect/apm/errors.flow
